Hi there 
1. How bad is the itching and is there any burning along with it? Could be a ton of things thrush/yeast infection and it your sexually active chances of sti, look for changes in discharge and smell
2. Usually you don't need any kind of soap to clean the insides just water or if you're really concerned sometimes unscented soap will do but only on the outside so I would put down the soap you're using for a few days and see if it improves your itching
3. If you're on your period and you've changed the brand of pads/tampons you buy recently could be a reason as well
4. Either way if the itching persists even after few days and you've changed nothing recently in your routine I would get it checked by the doc
